evals.prompt: Add comments to the file evals/files/Order.java following the profession-commentor standard.
evals.expected_output: Order.java with Javadoc on the class, all public methods, and only the non-obvious fields. Simple getters/setters should have Javadoc since they are public methods. Fields like paidAt and notes get comments, id/orderNumber/totalAmount do not.

evals.prompt: Add comments to the file evals/files/OrderService.java following the profession-commentor standard.
evals.expected_output: OrderService.java with Javadoc on the class, all public methods including @param, @return, and @throws where applicable. The findById method should document the IllegalArgumentException, markAsPaid should document OrderNotFoundException. Inline comments should explain the why of the stream filter/sort, not just what it does.

evals.prompt: Add comments to the file evals/files/OrderController.java following the profession-commentor standard.
evals.expected_output: OrderController.java with Javadoc on the controller class, all endpoint methods, and both DTO records. Each record should have @param for each component. The controller methods should have @param and @return. The factory method 'from' on OrderResponse should get Javadoc.
